verdict.rationale: Capacities exposes a REST API that can 'access, create and manipulate' content and supports full/automated exports and bulk migration imports (Notion/Obsidian/Apple Notes) as one-time bulk transfers, but there is no documented batch/bulk-update endpoint, multi-select action, or scripted operation that lets an AI agent apply changes across many items in one call. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, evidence of bulk tagging/editing/deleting across items, and independent confirmation that the API supports multi-item mutations.
